headline: Linn of Mercy Flares as Central Fronts Sustain Heavy Attrition
war_summary: Linn of Mercy has sharply reignited over the past three hours, breaking its earlier quiet with five rapid strategic base actions and escalating clashes centered around Outwich Ranch and Lathair. Weathered Expanse remains intensely contested, logging another recent base exchange while generating more than four hundred casualties across the two-hour window. Further west, Callahan's Passage and the Nevish Line continue to bear the war's heaviest attrition, each registering over a thousand bilateral losses in the last two hours even as physical line shifts pause. Coastal fighting saw renewed friction in Kuura Strand with fresh base movement near Talven, whereas previous flare-ups in Godcrofts and Mooring County have begun cooling into localized exchanges. Meanwhile, the Dead Lands and southern territories remain at a low operational simmer, leaving current momentum tightly concentrated across the contested central and northern corridors.
